create_plot_directive: create a reStructuredText plot directive that renders horizontal bar charts as SVG using matplotlib
register_mcss_plot_directive: register the plot directive with m.css settings and configure the matplotlib font family
reset_svg_hashsalt: reset the matplotlib SVG hash salt counter to zero for a new page of plots
register_pelican_signals: register Pelican signals to configure plots on initialization and reset hash salt per content object
review_style_mapping: review the style_mapping dictionary that maps named color styles to hex codes for bar chart colors
